prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene captures the chaotic energy of a bustling restaurant kitchen. On the far left, a chef with spiky blue hair wears a pristine white uniform and stands firmly next to a towering stack of gleaming silver pots. In the center foreground, a young woman with short pink hair and round glasses holds a clipboard tightly against her chest while looking at a large digital timer mounted on the wall above her. To her right, a burly man in a stained apron wipes sweat from his brow with a rag, his posture slumped in exhaustion. Behind him, a sleek black cat sits on a high shelf, observing the chaos with narrowed yellow eyes. Near the back counter, a teenager with green headphones around their neck chops carrots rapidly on a wooden board, their knife moving in a blur. Beside them, an older woman with gray hair tied in a bun points sharply at a missing ingredient list pinned to the cabinet. A small brown dog lies under the central prep table, its tail wagging slightly as it watches the falling scraps. On the far right, a delivery person in a yellow helmet hands a sealed package to a waiter with slicked-back black hair who reaches out eagerly. Above the stove, steam rises vigorously from three boiling kettles, obscuring the upper cabinets slightly. The floor is scattered with a few dropped napkins, adding to the sense of hurried movement. There is no sunlight streaming through windows, as the space is entirely enclosed. There is no electronic tablet visible on any surface, only paper lists and analog tools. The blue-haired chef glances toward the pink-haired woman, acknowledging her urgency. The black cat stretches a paw toward a hanging ladle, teasing the air. The green-headphone teenager looks up briefly at the pointing woman, nodding in understanding. The yellow-helmeted person turns away immediately after handing off the package, ready to leave. Every character displays distinct facial expressions ranging from focus to fatigue, rendered with sharp lines and bold colors typical of the genre. The spatial arrangement creates a dynamic flow from left to right, guiding the eye through the various stations of work. The interaction between the staff and the environment feels tactile and immediate, emphasizing the physical labor involved. The absence of modern digital devices highlights the traditional, hands-on nature of this particular culinary establishment.
